channel.title: Azure SQL on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in Azure SQL on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Database Agent for SQL with contextual Copilot
item.description:
Database Agent for SQL is now in public preview with contextual Copilot-generated recommendations for detected database issues. The recommendations are grounded in available issue evidence and explain why the issue matters, the likely cause, and the next step.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Database Hub real-time performance dashboards
item.description:
Microsoft Fabric Database Hub now provides built-in, real-time performance dashboards for Microsoft SQL, Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server, and Azure Cosmos DB. The dashboards are accessible from the Performance page and consolidate monitoring in one place.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for mid-November 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL preview updates in mid-November 2026 add new SSMS Create and Apply wizards for working with .dacpac and .bacpac files. These wizards consolidate and replace the older workflow for creating and applying these package files.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Managed Redis database integration guidance
item.description:
Azure has launched generally available guidance for integrating Azure Managed Redis with Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server, Azure Cosmos DB, and Azure SQL. The update provides caching guidance, reference architectures, and related materials for application integration.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SQL Managed Instance updates for mid-November 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL Managed Instance received mid-November 2026 updates, including higher transaction throughput for Next-gen General Purpose instances with log rates up to 220 MiB/s and increased performance. The release is generally available.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SQL updates for mid-November 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL received mid-November 2026 updates, including fuzzy string matching for comparing strings by similarity rather than exact match. The provided article excerpt is truncated and does not include the full list of changes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Database Hub in Microsoft Fabric
item.description:
Microsoft Fabric Database Hub is now generally available. It provides a unified place to discover, manage, monitor, and optimize databases across SQL Server, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Azure Cosmos DB, and Fabric SQL.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Fuzzy string match is available across Microsoft SQL offerings
item.description:
Fuzzy string match is now generally available across Microsoft SQL offerings, including Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, SQL database in Microsoft Fabric, and SQL Server 2025. It lets you compare strings based on similarity or difference.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: SQL performance monitoring for Azure SQL Managed Instance
item.description:
Microsoft has released a public preview of Microsoft-managed performance monitoring for Azure SQL Managed Instance. It is intended to replace custom scripts and disconnected tools for monitoring business-critical workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SQL updates for late-September 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL added larger Hyperscale Premium compute options in Azure SQL Database, including 160-vCore and 192-vCore SKUs. Microsoft says these provide up to 50% more compute capacity than the previous top tier.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for late-September 2026
item.description:
Late-September 2026 Azure SQL preview updates include Database Hub in Microsoft Fabric. The hub provides a unified experience for discovering, managing, monitoring, and optimizing databases across SQL Server and Azure SQL.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Database DevOps in SSMS powered by SQL projects
item.description:
SSMS now supports generally available Database DevOps using Microsoft.Build.Sql projects. This gives users a local definition of database objects to help implement, manage, and collaborate on database changes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL Dev Hub
item.description:
Azure SQL Dev Hub is in public preview as a central starting point for building applications with Azure SQL. It provides guidance for connecting from .NET, Python, Node.js, and Java, and supports development workflows including AI agents.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SQL Managed Instance updates for late-September 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL Managed Instance received late-September 2026 updates, including a flexible memory feature that lets you change the memory allocated to an instance without changing the instance size.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for mid-September 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL added a public preview for soft delete on logical servers. When a logical server is deleted, it enters a soft-deleted state and can be restored within the configured window.

  • Source: Azure Updates
